Container.Name: expense-pilot-beta
Container.Overview: Development beta. Use a separate data folder and port. A clearer view of every dollar. Self-hosted Australian employment and business expenses, receipt review, invoices, quotes, budgets, vehicle records and overnight spending. Optional receipt AI, PocketSmith bank feeds and email use your own configured services. No Expense Pilot cloud account is required. Prepare the appdata folder as described in the installation guide. Create your owner account on your trusted network before enabling remote access. The setup token is optional and AI is configured inside the app. The optional iPhone companion remains in testing.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: expenses receipts invoices quotes budget bookkeeping finance australia pocketsmith ollama
Container.Requires: 64-bit x86 Docker host. Optional AI services need their own resources. Appdata must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100.
Container.Changes: v1.0.5: Public-release packaging, matching dependency sources and Community Apps installation metadata.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, receipts and session key. Keep this mapping during updates.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Optional first-run protection. Leave blank for token-free setup, or enter a random value of at least 24 characters. Complete owner setup before exposing the server remotely.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Use true behind HTTPS. Use false for initial LAN HTTP setup.
